authors_reviews.title: Great for emergencies
authors_reviews.text: Needed this for a pet emergency recently. So glad I had this and it has what I needed. Nice and compact and good size, good for storing away or traveling. A nice amount of emergency supplies and quality content.
authors_reviews.author: MELY

authors_reviews.title: Total Bargain For the Quality. Love Having This For Backup Safety.
authors_reviews.text: Absolutely love how much fits in this pouch. I bought it as a backup for my truck in case I need it for my dog while not at home. It’s easy to transport by fitting in my glovebox, center console or the back pouch of a seat. It has quality products inside that I don’t question if they’re safe for my dog. The quantity of first aid supplies plus the free swabs was definitely more than I expected for the cost. It was worth the money. I have no worries my dog will be safe in an emergency whether it’s something small or until I can get him to an emergency vet for further assistance if something were to happen when we’re out and about. It gives me so much peace of mind.
authors_reviews.author: A. D. York

authors_reviews.title: Pet first aid kit is a wise investment for your peace of mind and your pets health
